entries.title: Monotonic delegation intersection
entries.requirement: Downstream effective authority is the semantic intersection of upstream effective authority and child-declared scope; ambiguity is non-affirmative.

entries.title: Half-open temporal validity
entries.requirement: Validity is effective_from <= evaluation_time < effective_until unless a stricter profile rule applies.

entries.title: Clock and event ordering safety
entries.requirement: Clock ambiguity or unresolved contradictory event ordering cannot yield affirmative material state.

entries.title: Non-applicability boundary
entries.requirement: not_applicable cannot represent missing, invalid, unavailable, unsupported, stale, conflicting, or otherwise unresolved required authority.

entries.title: Authoritative conflict safety
entries.requirement: Unresolved conflict between simultaneously competent authoritative sources is non-affirmative.

entries.title: Revocation effectiveness separated from convergence
entries.requirement: Effective revocation makes new authority evaluations non-affirmative even while enforcement convergence is pending or failed.

entries.title: Reproducible evaluation tuple
entries.requirement: Consequential decisions retain evaluation time, policy, authoritative record set/checkpoints, freshness and competence state sufficient for reconstruction.

entries.title: Proof input semantics
entries.requirement: Proof interoperability requires declared proof-input transformation and related suite semantics; proof validity alone is not authority.

entries.title: Monotonic multidimensional status composition
entries.requirement: Independent status dimensions compose toward safety; restrictive or indeterminate material state cannot be cancelled by an affirmative dimension.

entries.title: Privacy-preserving continuity
entries.requirement: Cross-context continuity for scoped identifiers requires an authorized linkage mechanism and cannot be inferred from correlation.

entries.title: Schema correction authority boundary
entries.requirement: Schema-only corrections cannot change normative semantics or broaden authority without a Candidate Specification version change.

entries.title: Historical retroactivity requires governance basis
entries.requirement: Retroactive effect requires a competent governance basis; absent that basis historical interpretation is not upgraded to asserted retroactive invalidity.
